description: Step into an extraordinary evening of Bollywood Music on the day of Halloween.

Step into an extraordinary evening of Bollywood Music on the day of Halloween.

About this Event

🎃 SPOOKYWEEN: A Halloween Bollywood Party! 👻🚂
PRYM Events by Bollywood Bash presents
Get ready for a haunting night 
Bring your crew, dress in your Halloween best, and join us for Bollywood beats, live dhol, and nonstop dancing!
⏰ CLOCKS GO BACK. WE KEEP GOING!
When the clock strikes 2 AM, it turns back to 1 AM—giving us ONE EXTRA HOUR OF MUSIC! 🔥
🗓️ Friday, October 30 2026
🚪 Doors open: 9 PM
🎶 Party until 2 AM after the clock change
🎟️ Tickets: $20
🔞 21+ | Valid government-issued photo ID required

🎧 BOLLYWOOD DJ & LIVE DHOL
Dance to your favorite Bollywood hits, throwback anthems, and high-energy party remixes.
👻 HALLOWEEN VIBES
Bring your spooky, glamorous, or most creative look and get ready for a night full of music and memories!
🍸 DRINKS & BOTTLE SERVICE
Enjoy your favorite drinks, or reserve a dedicated table with bottle service for your group. Drinks and bottle service are available for purchase.
👉 Grab your tickets and join the SPOOKYWEEN madness!
📲 Tickets, tables, group discounts & bottle service:
Call 201-954-5839 or 929-402-8376

TERMS & CONDITIONS
This is a 21+ event. A valid government-issued photo ID is required for entry.Respectful behavior is required. Harassment, inappropriate touching, abusive language, or disruptive conduct toward guests, staff, or performers will not be tolerated.All ticket sales are final. Tickets are nonrefundable and nonexchangeable.Photography and video recording will take place for event promotion. For photo or video removal requests, message @bollywoodbash_events on Instagram.Management reserves the right to refuse admission or remove anyone for disruptive behavior or failure to follow venue rules.Daylight saving time ends early Sunday, November 1. The advertised closing time is 2 AM after clocks turn back. One extra Hour!

PLEASE DON’T DRINK AND DRIVE. PLAN A SAFE RIDE HOME.
